title: 57th GST Council Meeting Rescheduled to October 7, 2026!
content:
# 57th GST Council Meeting Rescheduled to October 7, 2026!

Ek important update hai! Government ne 57th Goods and Services Tax (GST) Council meeting ko reschedule karne ka announce kiya hai.

Initially, the meeting was set for September 12, 2026, in New Delhi. However, due to a scheduling conflict, the date has been revised.

*   **Original Meeting Date:** September 12, 2026
*   **New Meeting Date:** October 7, 2026
*   **Venue:** New Delhi
*   **Reason for Postponement:** India is hosting the BRICS Leaders' Summit in New Delhi on September 12-13, 2026, which led to the rescheduling.
*   **Preparatory Meetings:** GST officers ki preparatory meetings ab October 5 aur 6, 2026 ko hongi.
*   **Official Communication:** This decision was officially communicated through an Office Memorandum dated September 6, 2026, issued by the GST Council Secretariat.

## Read the Official Document
*   [Download the Official Notification/Circular here](https://gstc.gov.in)

*Published on: 8 September 2026*
